## Overview

**Fridge Price Prediction** — part of the [Data Science Projects Collection](https://github.com/PaulChanCyber/Data-Science-Project-). Appliance price regression from brand, capacity, and energy features.

## Background & Motivation

PDS **Fridge Price prediction** module in the collection—retail regression on scraped appliance listings.

Appliance SKUs differ by capacity, energy class, and brand—shoppers need spec-adjusted fair price signals.

## Project Guidelines & Objectives

- Collect refrigerator listings (brand, capacity, energy rating, features, price)
- Handle missing/outlier prices
- Encode categoricals; scale numerics
- Train regression; analyze residuals for over/under-priced units

## Data Collection & Preparation

Scraped fridge/appliance listings from Cambodian e-commerce or classified sites.

## Methodology & Analysis

pandas cleaning; one-hot/ordinal encoding; scikit-learn regression; residual plots.

## Model Evaluation

Test-set RMSE; listing-level fair-price flags.

## Results & Key Learnings

Spec-adjusted fridge price guidance for consumers and resellers.
